summary: The market is pinned near the day's lows with the Nifty testing 22,600. Banks are still the main drag, and there's no sign of dip-buying yet on expiry day.

detail.laggards: Bank Nifty (−1%+): HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, Kotak Bank; Bajaj Finance, HDFC Life, Tata Motors PV
detail.tone: Little changed from 10:00: the last firm print was 22,605.55 (−0.77%), and the latest headline has the Sensex down more than 600 with the Nifty still testing 22,600. The selling has slowed, but there's no bounce.
watch: A decisive break below 22,600 into expiry settlement
Bank Nifty: heavyweights HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank set the index's direction
